directory_policies.notes.3: GRE policy: GRE is optional, and subject tests are not required.
directory_policies.notes.4: English policy: Published CS routes include TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 7 and DET 115, plus degree-based alternatives. Complete test-age and waiver applicability still need review before automated clearance.
directory_policies.notes.5: Deadlines: Fall 2027 on-campus MCS: February 10 scholarship consideration; May 1 international deadline; July 1 domestic deadline. Online June 15 is a separate schedule.

source_excerpt: GRE subject test scores are not required.
fact_summary: CS admissions gives optional GRE, English pathways and distinct international/domestic on-campus deadlines; the new international date is displayed as source-bound policy context.
